preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 0 for x in [b, d, s])
preconditions.description: b, d, s are non-negative integers representing the counts of breakfasts, dinners, and suppers, respectively.
At least one meal count is positive.

postconditions.description: The output is the minimum number of meals Vasiliy could have missed, where min_missed(b, d, s) is the smallest integer such that there exists a valid stay duration (number of days) and arrival/departure times that account for the given meal counts without exceeding the total possible meals.
